decision.observation: Reverse carried the car clear of the pines and down onto the grass below the tarmac; it now reads 6 mph in gear R with the red X lit. The road runs across the screen above the car from lower-left to upper-right, with puddles on the left half and a dark reddish object at the far right.
decision.hypothesis: The car faces the tarmac and needs only to climb back onto it. Straight forward throttle should mount the road without the sideways drift that steering caused.
decision.memory: Reversing twice pulled the car out of the treeline but overshot below the road. A plain forward throttle is the least risky mount from here; steering has repeatedly slid the car off the far side.
